scenes.conflict: A recorded halo appears to contain more than wind.
scenes.decision: The voice is not proven part of the source recording.
scenes.reveal: The Ring tape becomes a disputed object.
scenes.continuity: Separate optical halo from solar corona; no literal portent or verified causal claim.

scenes.conflict: An impossible voice destabilizes Nia's confidence in a recording.
scenes.decision: She suspects an edit rather than accepting the voice's authority.
scenes.continuity: The audio-app playback differs from room-perceived voice; no external visible UI.

scenes.conflict: Mateo needs to respond clinically while perceiving diverging immediate actions.
scenes.decision: He chooses care instead of pursuing the phenomenon.
scenes.reveal: Anomalous response has a physiological cost.
scenes.continuity: No Nexus HUD, no confirmed prediction; eclipse eyewear outside totality.

scenes.conflict: Elias has a spatial overlay he cannot share or explain.
scenes.decision: He conceals the experience from his colleague.
scenes.reveal: The imaginary corridor contains recurring geometry.
scenes.continuity: Not a companion dialogue; only Elias perceives corridor.

scenes.conflict: Mara balances extraordinary eyewitness reports with valid astronomical data.
scenes.decision: She classifies uncorroborated testimony as pending.
scenes.reveal: The geographic X is scientifically real; its fictional effects are unproven.
scenes.continuity: 2017 and 2024 tracks must be separate events; no simultaneity.

scenes.conflict: At totality, different awakeners perceive fragments of the same geometry.
scenes.decision: Nia questions Vesper rather than trusting it; others act independently.
scenes.reveal: An internal source-confidence interface appears, exclusive to Nia.
scenes.continuity: Corona appears at totality; Nexus visible only subjectively; Vesper is not in other hosts.

scenes.conflict: Mateo discovers he cannot reproduce the divergence at will.
scenes.reveal: A small physical inconsistency deepens the mystery.
scenes.continuity: Rescue patient and bag damage carefully tracked; no arbitrary ability mastery.

scenes.conflict: Nia demands proof that Vesper knows more than Nia already knows.
scenes.decision: Vesper concedes its first observation comes from Nia's own knowledge.
scenes.reveal: Another tape labeled STORM/2017 supplies an actionable clue.
scenes.continuity: No omniscience; proof standard remains unsatisfied, consent remains central.

scenes.conflict: Leena receives unconfirmed reports of a recognizable symbol.
scenes.decision: She refuses indiscriminate tracking yet retains a concealed archive.
scenes.reveal: The pattern predates 2017; antagonist institution enters only as a pressure.
scenes.continuity: No revelation of Cartographer's identity; earlier paper archives not proof of eclipse physics.

scenes.conflict: Nia can pursue the hidden audio source or walk away.
scenes.decision: She elects to investigate, demanding corroboration.
scenes.reveal: The pilot ends on evidence-seeking agency, not an unearned power grant.
scenes.continuity: Unpowered deck is blank in external reverse; subjective image only.
